title.provenance: An Act relating to health and safety -- Toxic Packaging Reduction Act

status.provenance: An Act relating to health and safety -- Toxic Packaging Reduction Act

pfas_definition.provenance: Perfluoroalkyl and polyfluoroalkyl substances or PFAS means all members of the class of fluorinated organic chemicals containing at least one fully fluorinated carbon atom.

type.provenance: 23-18.13-4. Prohibition/Schedule for removal of incidental amounts.

who.provenance: No product shall be offered for sale or for promotional purposes by its manufacturer or distributor in the state

action.provenance: No product shall be offered for sale or for promotional purposes by its manufacturer or distributor in the state

products.provenance: No food package to which PFAS have been intentionally introduced during manufacturing or distribution in any amount shall be offered for sale or for promotional purposes by its manufacturer or distributor in the state.
